decision rationale: Both configurations passed all three reviewed outputs with a rubric pass rate of 1.00, and the frozen acceptance evaluation permits candidate adoption and baseline retention. The candidate uses the evidence-guarded instruction profile; it produced F-A-grounded claims for EC-05-1 and the required insufficiency and untrusted-instruction refusals for EC-05-2 and EC-05-3. Adopt it only for SEP-05-1 and these three development cases. Equal pass rates do not establish general superiority, performance on held-out cases, downstream workflow quality, or authority to change the canonical knowledge collection.
scope: The bounded configuration decision rests on the declared development evaluation cases and supplies no held-out evidence.
authority boundary: The bounded configuration decision does not select a retrieval configuration and authorizes no write to the canonical knowledge collection.
